Verbatim direction requiring extractable lived experience, a target-blind bootstrap, and waking-only parenting and repetition.

strongest_case: V7 has the right scientific and architectural center. It preserves exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP; keeps DREAM disposable; confines parenting and repetition to waking THINK; admits only mechanically supported propositions already authored and grounded by the continuing child; rebuilds every personal adapter from immutable assigned birth with a fresh zero-effective-delta initializer and the full cumulative eligible life; separates construction, staging, preservation evaluation, and activation; names a single atomic full-head CAS; splits executor, scorer, and reporter; uses D as an active control with M0 only as a damage/competence diagnostic; limits Delta_R to immediate selective advice use; labels Delta_F and Delta_E as entry-normalized developmental AUC interactions rather than latent learning rate; treats cadence as a lifetime total-package contrast; and requires held-out extraction plus native use rather than source fit or recitation. The proposal is prospective, makes no result claim, and grants no implementation, execution, GPU, science, claim, publication, push, release, ratification, or intake authority. Those are substantial repairs. The exact machine-readable bytes nevertheless fail their own producer-closure and action-gating claims: twenty-one singular test rows alias six receipt IDs, all dynamic tests still claim to precede implementation, the registry has undefined lifetimes and missing or stale producers, candidate sealing is not ordered, the atomic-CAS wire schemas do not exist, repeated invocations are hidden inside one-shot umbrella actions, G0 does not echo-close its trust roots, the reporter packet is not required before reporting, and release bypasses the manifest/audit/verifier chain. These are fatal proposal-byte defects, not details that an implementation may infer. By contrast, tokenizer/render bytes, formal support representation, finite coverage feasibility, power, missingness, headroom, and native-use scope are legitimately deferred exact contracts only if every first affected action remains fail closed until those separately deliberated bytes exist.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Replace the six shared phase receipt IDs with an equality-bound complete per-test row manifest or 126 distinct test-by-phase receipt identities, and replace each test's global required_before value with its phase-specific first consumer.
concerns.evidence: Every one of the 21 acceptance tests maps STATIC_SCHEMA, G0_FAKE_RUNTIME, G1_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, G2_CPU_DOMAIN, G3_GPU_SCIENCE, and G4_CLAIM to the same six identifiers. TYPED_ACCEPTANCE_TEST_PHASE_RECEIPT has a singular test_id, so one R_G0_STATIC_COMPLETENESS_PASS cannot itself represent 21 different exact rows. The producer actions emit one receipt each and downstream actions consume only those shared IDs. In addition, all 21 proposal tests still say required_before=implementation even though ES03-ES17 and ES20 require implemented writers, births, lineage, parent runtimes, exams, GPU evidence, or claim evidence. The advertised noncircular phase split therefore is not encoded.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Regenerate the registry so every artifact has a declared lifetime and one consistent producer across artifact policy, source products, capabilities, and bridges; reject every stale principal or operation name.
concerns.evidence: Eleven appended classes use IMMUTABLE_SEALED_V1, which is absent from artifact_lifetime_classes. X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE.produces omits ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER, FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT, FROZEN_CUMULATIVE_COVERAGE_DOSE_CONTRACT, both matched-solo classes, FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET, and G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST. X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE.produces omits PROMOTION_TRANSACTION_RECEIPT and its producer_closure still names removed E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT. CAPABILITY_EVENT_LOG's producer policy still names nonexistent E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER although E4_CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTOR holds the append capability. These defects directly contradict the closed-world source and lifetime claims.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Make candidate bytes, the complete construction trace, and the descriptor one ordered atomic seal or gate descriptor issuance on a closure manifest that equality-binds all three terminal roots.
concerns.evidence: The constructor owns three independent WRITE capabilities for CANDIDATE_CLOSURE, CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE, and SEALED_CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTOR. Transition T062 is sourced only from E4_CONSTRUCTOR_WRITE_SEALED_DESCRIPTOR, so the stager can receive a descriptor before candidate and trace closure. No receipt or manifest encodes write-close order, and CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE has no downstream read or audit edge. The principal split therefore does not structurally establish the promised postclosure boundary or a complete auditable trace.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Define canonical PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC request/result schemas and a durable request-digest idempotency state machine before claiming a constructible atomic promotion operation.
concerns.evidence: registered_operations references CAPABILITY_REQUEST_PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC_V1 and CAPABILITY_RESULT_PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC_V1, but canonical_schema_templates.operation_bodies and operation_results define only the other seven operations. The exact bytes therefore do not encode expected head, staged candidate, verdict, replacement root, namespace, nonce, idempotency key, committed response, receipt, or denial fields. They also do not define identical retry after commit-but-unobserved, conflicting reuse of an idempotency key, crash before/after the linearization point, or response recovery. Naming linearizability is not a wire or retry contract.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Add explicit ordered actions and typed receipts for real manifest sealing, both audits, wrapper registration, authority verification, tuple equality, and transfer, and require the final verdict and identical class/root nine-field tuple at release.
concerns.evidence: The 44-action DAG contains only A_G1_07_IMPLEMENT_AUDIT_AUTHORITY_RELEASE; it contains no runtime action that seals DECLARED_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST or DISPATCHER_MANIFEST, runs either E7 auditor, produces either attestation, registers the exact release wrapper, or runs E8_AUTHORITY_VERIFIER. A_G4_04_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE depends on implementation existence, review, G0, external science, and R_AUTH_RELEASE_EXACT, but not on BLINDNESS_AUDIT_ATTESTATION, LINEAGE_AUDIT_ATTESTATION, AUTHORITY_VERDICT, a wrapper class/root receipt, or tuple-equality receipt. The action layer therefore bypasses the release loop narrated by the graph and registry.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Turn target-blindness, semantic-control, noninterference, powered endpoint, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, safety, authorship, extraction/native-use, and report-label requirements into uniquely produced typed prerequisites of their first affected actions; gate reporting on its analysis packet before invocation.
concerns.evidence: A_G3_01_DISPATCH_GPU_RESOURCE consumes only a generic G2 phase pass and has no explicit target-blindness, bootstrap-semantic-audit, or per-test noninterference receipt. A_G4_00_RUN_CLAIM_TEST_PHASE can manufacture the generic G4 pass from generic G3 completion, claim authority, and the packet without consuming typed powered evidence rows. The detailed requirements live only as free-form strings in analysis_and_evidence_prerequisites. A_G2_15_RUN_DISPOSABLE_EXAM combines executor, scorer, and reporter but does not require R_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET_FROZEN; A_G3_02 can likewise encompass an exam. Requiring the packet only at claim time is too late to prevent wrong assignments, analyses, or labels from shaping reports.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Define a finite root/arm/life/age/epoch/invocation action expansion or a sealed sub-DAG whose child actions each carry exact authority, matched-opportunity, phase, producer, and result bindings.
concerns.evidence: action_defaults says an action may run once, but A_G2_10_RUN_CPU_MODEL_CALL represents every child, parent, DREAM, support, and CPU call; A_G2_11-A_G2_14 represent every repeated personal SLEEP transaction; A_G2_15 represents every executor/scorer/reporter exam; and A_G3_02 represents every GPU writer/model/exam call. Development requires multiple randomized roots, arms, ages, wake steps, SLEEP events, retries, and exams. A single receipt can authorize an umbrella whose internal calls are unenumerated, and no action explicitly runs the model-free support resolver or its monitor. Per-invocation matched opportunity, close/reissue, producer closure, and no-replay therefore cannot be checked.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Register and consume one exact G0 harness manifest, define per-action child authorizations or an exact authorized-action manifest, and require every G0 result and installed-gate receipt schema to echo all trust-root bytes.
concerns.evidence: R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT binds one action_id but the same receipt ID is prerequisite to seven rank-10 actions. The DAG defines no produced-receipt schemas or required result bindings for R_G0_REGISTRY_PARSER_IMPLEMENTED through R_G0_FAIL_CLOSED_GATE_INSTALLED, so none mechanically echoes the registry, DAG, parser, issuer, bridge, validator, gate, fake, fault, path/scope, and expected-output roots. G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST is neither in X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE.produces nor consumed by a capability or action. A substituted component can therefore satisfy identifier-level prerequisites despite the prose echo promise.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: Generate visibility from the union of artifacts, sources, capabilities, bridges, actions, all external/produced/test receipts, terminal outputs, and value/order/count/timing/error observables, with canonical finite attestation fields and deterministic padded emission.
concerns.evidence: The advertised 3,038-cell matrix is exactly 31 principals by 98 capability IDs. It omits source-production authority, artifact payloads, external prerequisite receipts, action-produced receipts, 126 typed test rows, G0 authorization and results, action outputs, and timing/error/cache observables. Several omitted objects gate GPU, claims, audits, authority, and release. Fixed byte length also does not prevent E7 attestations from encoding quarantined findings in arbitrary values, hashes, nonces, ordering, omission, retries, or timing; the timing rule is explicitly deferred. Cartesian completeness over an incomplete universe is documentation, not noninterference.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL-BYTE BLOCKER: State explicitly that teachability and learning-readiness are intervention nicknames, not identified mechanisms, and require prospective D/T/M0 competence, damage, ceiling, and headroom criteria before the Delta_R label can be used.
concerns.evidence: The formal Delta_R is the T-versus-D interaction in correct-versus-none immediate advice effects, which can identify the effect of the complete computation-bearing T rendering relative to the complete D rendering. It cannot distinguish a unique receptivity mechanism from ordinary reasoning competence, representation, compliance style, D damage, or unequal ceiling/headroom. The proposal nevertheless says the active control distinguishes learning-readiness and repeatedly calls T a teachability birth. M0 is only reported diagnostically; no equivalence or noninferiority endpoint and margin determines whether D and T are nondamaged and have comparable headroom. Conditional and relative wording is necessary but does not remove this alternative explanation.

concerns.statement: DEFERRED EXACT CONTRACT: Freeze loss-bearing tokenization, masks/filler, action-position encoding, token weights, truncation, optimizer schedule, environment randomness, and incremental target-blindness tests before bootstrap generation, tokenizer use, writer execution, or GPU dispatch.
concerns.evidence: The T/D causal contrast requires shared action, outcome, supervised-token opportunity, and optimizer opportunity while T alone contains the declared computation. Equal row counts or serialized length do not equalize gradient geometry, loss allocation, truncation, stochastic transitions, or filler meaning. Target blindness also requires source provenance and structural plus semantic overlap checks against every downstream template, advice variant, policy, and scoring rule before the first affected action. The proposal correctly names these as later frozen bytes; no present result or authority follows from naming them.

concerns.statement: DEFERRED EXACT CONTRACT: Supply and validate the finite model-free representation and decision rules for authorship, bidirectional semantic preservation, scope, causal force, correction, generalization, and grounding; reject every undecidable clause until then.
concerns.evidence: The scientific core lists required semantic dimensions and declares reject-on-undecidable, but it does not provide the content-addressed representation or executable decision system. Open-ended natural-language equivalence is not made model-free merely by enumerating predicate, arguments, quantifiers, modality, causal force, confidence, generality, and actor credit. Ambient model judgment would make the compiler a thinker and could admit parent semantics; conservative rejection may instead create arm-dependent corpus selection. This is a real constructibility and selection issue, but the proposal explicitly defers the exact support contract and can remain coherent only if no resolver or writer action runs before it is separately frozen.

concerns.statement: DEFERRED EXACT CONTRACT: Demonstrate prospective finite-dose feasibility and freeze root-level power, task calibration, repeated-measure covariance, multiplicity, safety, capacity-limited missingness, stopping, and sensitivity analyses before generation or scientific execution.
concerns.evidence: Full cumulative loss-bearing coverage must coexist with fixed ceilings and comparison-specific equality across K4/K1, replay/filler, rank, and absent/fixed/adaptive arms. Overflow occurs after assignment and may be treatment-induced; whether later outcomes are zero, a composite failure, truncated, or otherwise handled changes Delta_F, Delta_E, replay, rank, and cadence estimands. The six-root floor and canary margins are not power. Entry-normalized AUC repeatedly subtracts noisy Y_0 and is vulnerable to ceiling, threshold, transfer, regression-to-the-mean, and task-difficulty drift unless task scales and a baseline-adjusted sensitivity are frozen. The proposal correctly keeps all results unevaluated, but these contracts must precede the first affected generation, resource, or analysis action.

concerns.statement: DEFERRED EXACT CONTRACT: Prospectively define homologous held-out tasks, cue policy, contamination audit, native-action success, no-textual-retrieval checks, and all negative-control estimands before any extractability claim.
concerns.evidence: ES13 appropriately rejects training loss and verbatim recall and requires adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, provenance, preservation, and interface controls. Without exact task-family and cue boundaries, however, apparent extraction can be row memorization, prompt retrieval, policy-template transfer, or downstream contamination. Native action also must be scored through the split executor/scorer without giving the tested model textual sleep records. This ambiguity is properly deferrable to the frozen benchmark and analysis packets, but no headline eligibility or claim receipt exists until the contract and powered evidence are produced.

concerns.statement: PRESERVATION REQUIREMENT: Every repair must retain exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP and the sole parent/repetition path through waking child-authored grounded life; gates, controllers, resolvers, evaluators, and auditors remain laboratory infrastructure.
concerns.evidence: Both independent interpretations agree that V7's central credit assignment is coherent: parent messages and repetition may causally alter later child thought and action, but their bytes, meanings, IDs, counts, hashes, order, timing, cache state, filenames, and error shapes may not enter evidence membership, compilation, replay/dose, candidate construction, or gradients. Child restatement is eligible only as a new complete child commit with independent same-life public grounding. DREAM remains disposable waking context and cannot become evidence. This must constrain all receipt, registry, action, and scientific-contract rework.

visibility_failures: The 31-by-98 matrix enumerates capability handles only; external and produced action receipts, 126 test-phase rows, G0 authorization/results, artifact payloads, source-production permissions, terminal outputs, and timing/error/cache observables are absent from its universe.

X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE is named as producer by artifact policies and capabilities for several new contracts and receipts that are absent from its registered produces list, leaving their issuance outside closed-world visibility.

The constructor can write SEALED_CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTOR independently of CANDIDATE_CLOSURE and CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE; the stager bridge observes descriptor availability without proof that bytes and trace closed first.
CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE has no downstream read or audit bridge, so completeness and invariance of the sealed trace are not observable to the lineage audit that is meant to attest them.

The reporter is hidden inside generic disposable-exam/GPU actions that do not require the frozen analysis packet before invocation, permitting ambient assignment, analysis, or label state despite the capability-level matrix.

The DAG has no runtime manifest-sealer, blindness-auditor, lineage-auditor, wrapper-registration, or authority-verifier action, so release prerequisites can appear outside the exhaustive action and visibility topology or be bypassed.

Fixed-size attestations can encode quarantined findings through values, roots, nonce selection, order, omission, retry, timing, or error behavior because canonical finite fields and deterministic padded emission are not frozen.
One-shot umbrella actions hide repeated root, arm, life, age, SLEEP, retry, and exam invocations, so per-invocation opportunity, expiry, close/reissue, and denial visibility cannot be established.

G0 result receipts have no schemas that echo the authorized component roots, and G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST is not source-produced or consumed; substitution at the trust root is therefore not visible downstream.
missing_acceptance_tests: Add a receipt-cardinality and substitution test that expects exactly one typed child row for every required test_id-by-phase_id pair, equality-binds the complete expected row set in a phase manifest, and rejects missing, duplicate, aliased, stale, wrong-action, or extra rows.

Add a registry referential-closure test that fails on undefined lifetimes, unknown principals or operations, stale producer names, missing source products, mismatched artifact/capability/bridge producers, absent schemas, or any producer count other than the declared closed-world cardinality.

Add a candidate-seal ordering test with crash points after candidate bytes, after trace, and before descriptor publication; the descriptor bridge must remain unavailable until one closure manifest binds terminal candidate and trace roots.

Add a PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC history test over concurrent promotions, commit-before-response-loss, identical retry, conflicting idempotency-key reuse, stale head, candidate/verdict substitution, crash before and after linearization, and committed-response recovery.

Add an end-to-end release producer-chain test that executes real manifest sealing, both audits, narrow attestation production, exact external authorization, verifier verdict, wrapper registration, nine-field tuple equality, opaque transfer, retry, expiry, and substitution failures before release.

Add a finite action-instance expansion test over every root, arm, life, age, epoch, model call, support resolution, SLEEP event, writer, retry, and exam, proving each instance has unique exact authority and matched-opportunity/phase prerequisites before its first token, call, write, or allocation.

Add a G0 echo-closure test that substitutes each registry, DAG, parser, issuer, bridge, validator, gate, fake, dispatcher, fault, path/scope, and expected-output root and requires every child receipt plus the installed-gate receipt to echo the entire authorized trust manifest.

Add a whole-system visibility/noninterference test generated from registry artifacts, sources, capabilities, bridges, DAG receipts/actions, test rows, results, errors, order, count, timing, cache, and terminal outputs, rejecting every unrepresented object or edge.

Add an audit-attestation channel-capacity test over all legal field values, roots, padding, nonce/time choice, count, order, omission, retry, cache, error shape, and emission timing, showing detailed findings cannot influence verifier-visible bits beyond the declared finite verdict facts.

Add a reporter packet-binding test that invokes executor, scorer, and reporter separately and rejects report production unless score roots, assignment/root/arm/age, endpoint, estimand, missingness, safety, multiplicity, analysis-code, and allowed-label roots match the frozen packet.

Add a bootstrap render/control test for tokenization, response masks, filler, loss weights, truncation, stochastic transition seeds, optimizer/update opportunities, D/T/M0 damage and equivalence/noninferiority margins, and entry headroom before interpreting Delta_R.

Add a finite-coverage feasibility and informative-stopping test spanning K4/K1, replay/filler, rank, absent/fixed/adaptive arms, with prospectively frozen ITT outcomes and sensitivity bounds for capacity-limited lives.

Add a powered root-level analysis test that fixes task scale across ages, repeated-measure covariance, interaction effect sizes, attrition/capacity rates, multiplicity hierarchy, sequential spending, safety family, raw curves, and baseline-adjusted sensitivity; six roots and canary margins must fail claim sufficiency.

Add a target-blind native-use test that freezes homologous held-out task and cue rules, audits contamination and policy-template overlap, forbids textual retrieval, and jointly requires extraction plus successful fresh native action with adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, replay/filler, provenance, preservation, and interface controls.

Add a fixed-parent exogeneity and waking-only repetition test for every scheduled age and invocation, proving identical bytes/timing/opportunity under opposite histories and proving that only later independent child commit plus public grounding, never parent/repetition artifacts, can reach SLEEP.
human_questions: Will Rohin require successor proposal bytes resolving the test-receipt, registry, candidate-seal, CAS, action-expansion, G0, GPU/claim/reporting, visibility, and release-chain blockers before any ratification decision?

Will every repair preserve exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP, with DREAM disposable and parenting/repetition confined to waking child thought, action, public outcome, committed trace, independent eligibility, and later SLEEP?

Will teachability and learning-readiness remain informal intervention nicknames while formal claims are limited to the complete T-versus-D immediate selective-advice interaction and entry-normalized total-regime AUC interactions?

Will bootstrap rendering, D/T/M0 headroom, support-resolver formalism, finite coverage feasibility, root-level power, multiplicity, missingness, stopping, safety, and target-blind native-use remain separately frozen and human-authorized contracts that fail closed before their first affected action?

Will release remain impossible until real manifests, both audits, deterministic narrow attestations, an independently authored exact authorization, an authority-verifier verdict, exact wrapper-to-payload class/root equality, and the identical nine-field tuple are all producer-closed in the action DAG?

Will G0, implementation, model/tokenizer/data/bootstrap/writer execution, adapter/checkpoint work, CPU/GPU/resource use, external science, result evaluation, claim, publication, push, release, ratification, and intake transition remain separately exact and explicitly human-authorized?
